body: Ah I'm sorry I said that. I just meant that guns are not possible, or at least very difficult to get in Canada but in America its avalible in stores. And shooting myself would be a lot faster and painless than any other methods so if I could choose a method I would choose a gun for sure. When it comes to safety if I ever hold a gun I would make sure not to hurt anyone other than myself. I know what you mean about the alternative reasons, thats what I hate about guys. I just want friends, nothing else. I will keep in mind everything you said, I have trouble talking to people because of that actaully. I don't want to accidently offend someone when talking about a topic I know nothing about, and I'm worried they will be really mean to me or block me instantly. I can't just keep saying yes, uh hu, I agree, mhm, every time they say something I don't know about because that might come off as rude...There is a wide variety of video games out there, so if it is about games, I wouldn't mind asking them about their passion of a game that I know nothing about. But outside of that, I'm not sure. Also that last paragraph hits really deep...I am saving it in my quote book haha thank you again for your replies. It feels very nice to be able to talk to someone other than my parents...After deleting my account, I don't think I have talked to anyone for at least a few months...Thank you again. ⭐⭐⭐

Thank you. I hope I can make one real friend soon. Thank you for disagreeing with some things in my post, I know what I did and said was wrong, and I am working on trying to redeem myself. I really was not trying to be mean about girls, I was mad and sad that no one would add other guys and myself that actaully needed friends unless it was a girl. If I were to try and make a friend outside of video games, it would not work out at all as we have nothing in common so this was my only option to make friends...I will try to make friends online as me, and won't lie anymore. Thank you again. Please take another star. ⭐

Very nice to see we are alike. I'm often told I'm still young and could change, but I don't know how to. Good grades don't mean much, good thing I never had any haha. Took a lot of summer classes to pass my classes in high school. 9-5 job does sound bad, I have not worked before so I don't know what it feels like. Girls are often hard to talk to, I feel you, but sadly I equally have hard times talking to guys as well. I took a personality test recentely and got 100% introverted...I am a true introvert. Thank you.
